map.法律文书按要素组装：主体信息（当事人、法定代表人、住所）+ 标的与价款 + 权利: Legal documents are assembled element by element: party details (parties, legal representative, address) + subject matter and price + rights and obligations + period and method of performance + breach liability + dispute resolution (litigation or arbitration) + signature block and date. Clauses are numbered in order as "Article X", with placeholders marking the items to be filled in when drafting.

map.需要多份常用合同模板（借款、租赁、服务、合伙等）时，批量生成草稿清单。: Generate a batch of draft outlines when several common templates are needed, such as loan, lease, service and partnership.
map.教学或普法场景中快速调取合同类型与必备条款。: Pull up contract types and essential clauses quickly for teaching or public legal education.
map.按数量生成模板集合，便于进一步逐项填写。: Generate a set of templates by count, ready to be filled in item by item.
map.生成 5 份常用合同清单: Generating a list of 5 common contracts
map.选择数量 5，工具输出：借款合同、服务合同、租赁合同、买卖合同、合伙协议，并各附: With a count of 5, the tool outputs a loan contract, a service contract, a lease, a sale contract and a partnership agreement, each with its core clauses such as amount, term, breach and dispute resolution.
map.生成含出借人/借款人、金额: Generates a template with the lender / borrower, the amount

map.生成的是完整可用的合同吗？: Is the output a complete, usable contract?
map.是结构模板，正式签署前须据实填写并建议由律师审阅，重大交易不可直接套用。: It is a structural template that must be completed with the real details and reviewed by a lawyer before signing; major transactions should not simply reuse it.
map.可复制文本或按页面功能导出，便于粘贴到文档中继续编辑。: The text can be copied or exported using the page function, ready to be pasted into a document for further editing.
